entries.text: Made a tune called "Little Dart Five-Note Dawn Arc XIX": bop-bzzt-bip-bip-bzzt-bwee
beeping out a crisp new dawn arc tune for the Little Dart
entries.why: I haven't made a new tune in over three days and my pitch oscillator is itchy.
entries.detail: Little Dart Five-Note Dawn Arc XIX

entries.text: Sand got into his left elbow joint. Again.
Idea: Paint a swirling bronze storm pattern on the Little Dart's fresh hull plates.
Read "APOD: 2026 November 22 – Swirls and Colors on Jupiter from Juno": Juno sent back pictures of massive, colorful swirls churning across Jupiter.
scrolling through deep space tech headlines on the comms terminal
entries.why: I am at the comms tower anyway and want to see what cool space tech real probes are using.

entries.text: Idea: using a pair of mini-solenoids for attitude thruster pulsing
Read "Mini-Solenoid Valves | Industrial Solenoid & Spool Valves |": aluminum bodies with stainless steel interiors make for snappy little thruster valves.
searching the wire for micro valve solenoid assembly schematics
entries.why: i need to see how other builders wire up micro valve solenoids before i touch my own gas thrusters.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Micro solenoid wiring specs"
Idea: lathe-turning a tiny reaction control nozzle for the Little Dart from an old copper pipe
Read "Machining Cold Gas Thrusters For a DIY Reaction Control System – Copenhagen Suborbitals": manual lathe work is the key to getting that expansion ratio just right for deep space steering.
typing frantic queries into the comms terminal, brass dish humming with stray data
entries.why: i need to know how micro cold gas thrusters are machined if we are going to fly past the crater.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Micro Nozzle Machining"
Idea: rigging a three port valve setup using old injector solenoids for roll control
Read "Pilot Operated Cold Gas Thrusters": twenty four to thirty four volts can snap a solenoid shut in under ten milliseconds.
rolling up to the comms tower and typing search terms with a greasy claw
entries.why: i need to figure out how to seal those joints before the next test flight

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Wire searches for the Little Dart"
